correctness.rationale: The full all-word induction treats empty, one-letter-absent, repeated-letter, singleton-opposite-run and longer-opposite-run cases; the 2004 append recurrence is inspected in full and specialized precisely. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove all k.

value.rationale: The size of a minimal forbidden scattered-subword basis is a natural combinatorial and representation-complexity invariant. The previously established run-count Fibonacci estimate may grow with alternations, but frequency is an independent resource parameter. This theorem gives a length-independent, sharp exponential bound when one letter occurs k times, with explicit equality witnesses and direct implications for output-size bounds of sparse-sequence antidictionaries; neither a small finite table nor a cosmetic substitution.
